name: Cron Job
description: Adds a line to a user's crontab, and reloads cron when it changes.

parameters.name: command
parameters.label: Command
parameters.help: Start with an absolute path. Runs with cron's environment, not the agent's.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.label: Hours
parameters.help: Cron hour field: * for every hour, 3 or 0,12 or */6.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.label: Minutes
parameters.help: Cron minute field: 0, 15,45 or */10. Runs every day of the month and week. Skipped on Windows.
